theme: It isn't you — real voices, honestly answered

days.x: The quiet fear nearly every disabled person takes into dating is three words long: is it me? It rarely is. It is a world that keeps forgetting to build the door. You were never the problem. #disabilitydating #disability

One wheelchair user put it perfectly: for years they could not tell if it was the disability or just them. It was neither. It was other people deciding who they were before a single word was said.

If you have ever laid awake asking "is it me", read this twice: it is not you. It is a world built with your door missing. We made Able2Love so you walk into a room that was actually built for you.
